An [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''janitor''' worked in a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on a [[Unidentified green-skied planet|green-skied planet]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the janitor was harassed by a pair of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] searching for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Dewell Bronk]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Bronk, who was on the world trying to flee from the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], saw the Ortolan being bullied and stepped into defend him. Recognizing their target, the clones then let the terrified Ortolan flee.<ref name="Incognito" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ortolan first appeared in "[[Incognito]]," a short story by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[John Jackson Miller]] and illustrated by [[Chris Scalf]], which was published in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 143|143]] in [[2013]]. The story served as a tie-in to Jackson's novel [[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']], which was released later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].
